reviews.title: MSI-MAG CORE I360 CPU COOLER
reviews.comment:
High-Performance Cooling – Equipped with a 360mm radiator and three 120mm PWM fans to deliver exceptional cooling efficiency for demanding CPUs.

ARGB Lighting – Customizable Addressable RGB lighting, fully controllable through MSI’s software, allowing synchronized effects with other components.

Durable & Reliable – Engineered with a robust pump design, reinforced tubing, and high-quality materials for long-lasting performance.

 Silent Operation – PWM fans provide dynamic speed adjustment, ensuring optimal cooling while keeping noise levels low.

 Universal Compatibility – Supports the latest Intel & AMD CPU sockets, making it a versatile choice for a wide range of builds.

Condition: Excellent – As Advertised
